review_type: Fresh independent source-only reverify of corrected Scrape procedure audit
scope_limits: No browser, native extension, test, build, release, database write, or fixture setup was run. This review evaluates proposed procedures and claims, not live acceptance outcomes.

original_findings.finding: Ordinary stale HTTP(S) tab claimed as deterministic recoverable no-receiver and deep-retry fixture
evidence: .research/scrape-remaining-procedure-audit.json: source_grounded_contract.capture_error and priority-2 procedure
src/lib/scrape/capture-with-fallback.ts:104-140 auto-injects and retries after no-receiver
src/hooks/use-scrape.ts:223-256 scrolls before the deep capture fallback
src/lib/scrape/capture-error.ts:89-145 distinguishes restricted, no-receiver and inject-failed actions
original_findings.assessment: The guaranteed stale-tab recipe was removed. Recoverable actions and deep retry are now conditional on a real observed failure, with the missing natural stimulus declared. Restricted-page Dismiss is kept separate.

original_findings.finding: No selected organization claimed as immediate signed-in save refusal and queue fixture
evidence: .research/scrape-remaining-procedure-audit.json: source_grounded_contract.organization and priority-3 procedure
src/lib/api/routes/auth.ts:21-23 delegates to the active-organization hold
src/lib/org/active-org.ts:357-385 opens the picker and waits for a choice
src/lib/sources/save-capture.ts:172-196 converts only an actual hold error into a refusal
original_findings.assessment: The correction describes picker/held request and removes missing selection as a deterministic member/admin refusal fixture. Signed-in queue variants remain explicitly without a controlled refusal setup.

original_findings.finding: T26 guest applicability previously discarded despite inventory no-request assertion
evidence: .research/scrape-remaining-procedure-audit.json: source_grounded_contract.recognition_role, priority-4 procedure, and material gaps
docs/stabilization/inventory.json: EXT-F-1007-T26 modes, guest step and expected result
src/lib/supabase/queries.ts:634-638 returns none without an access token before querying
original_findings.assessment: The correction preserves guest T26 as a no-lookup assertion; only lookup-failure/recovery and cross-organization branches are inapplicable to guest.

original_findings.finding: Restricted URL cannot prove Reload page or Try again
evidence: .research/scrape-remaining-procedure-audit.json: priority-2 procedure
src/lib/scrape/capture-error.ts:89-106 gives restricted URLs no recovery actions
original_findings.assessment: The corrected procedure counts restricted-page dismissal only for the nonrecoverable branch.

original_findings.finding: Guest sign-in refusal can populate a device-local queue, then successful signed-in retry clears it
evidence: .research/scrape-remaining-procedure-audit.json: priority-3 guest procedure
src/lib/sources/save-capture.ts:160-172 returns sign_in_required for a signed-out user
src/lib/sources/save-capture.ts:353-447 persists a refused save and drops it after successful landing
original_findings.assessment: The correction splits guest refusal from signed-in landing and requires source and queue readback. Nonempty article content and working device storage remain prerequisites.

original_findings.finding: Recognition spans RLS-visible organizations independent of selected write organization
evidence: .research/scrape-remaining-procedure-audit.json: priority-4 procedure and blockers
src/lib/supabase/queries.ts:634-674 has no selected-organization filter and returns found/none/unknown
src/hooks/use-page-recognition.ts:50-80 renders the lookup result
original_findings.assessment: The correction requires a real two-organization/RLS fixture and does not claim runtime visibility.

original_findings.finding: T26/T27 failure, T29 filing, and T30 delayed response lacked repeatable fixture details
evidence: .research/scrape-remaining-procedure-audit.json: priorities 4-6 blockers and prerequisites
docs/stabilization/inventory.json: EXT-F-1007-T26, T27, T29 and T30 preconditions
original_findings.assessment: The correction calls out missing lookup-outage, RLS, filing-target/Library and delayed-landing fixtures. It no longer treats those cells as runnable or passed. A controlled filing-refusal fixture is also still unspecified.

correction_only_findings.finding: The proposed no-selected-organization recognition check says to clear selected org but gives no supported UI action or authorized setup to reach that state for a signed-in principal.
evidence: .research/scrape-remaining-procedure-audit.json: priority-4 procedure, second step
src/lib/org/active-org.ts:477 declares clearActiveOrganization; current src search found no caller
docs/stabilization/inventory.json: EXT-F-1007-T26 requires the no-selected-organization dimension
correction_only_findings.effect: The cross-org selected-A check is source-grounded; the no-selection variant remains a procedure prerequisite. Do not manufacture state or count it as native coverage.

A_procedure_scope_correctness.assessment: All three refuted claims from the prior peer are corrected. Guest T26, restricted errors, and signed-in cross-org read scope are preserved. Member/admin refusal, natural recoverable capture error, lookup outage and RLS exclusion, controlled filing refusal, delayed response, and no-selection UI setup still lack repeatable approved procedures. Proposed observations are useful only after those prerequisites exist.

B_evidence_quality.assessment: The corrected audit is candid that it collected no current browser or server outcome. Its code and inventory citations justify procedure boundaries but cannot promote guest/member/admin cells, establish fixture availability, or verify cleanup. Prior native guest receipts remain bounded historical evidence, not a pass from this audit.
